Chain-binding soundness: a v2 capability token is admitted by the verifier iff its attenuation_proof.parent_scope_hash matches the trust-root scope hash (direct issue) or the last delegation link's signed scope_hash (delegated chain). The root-imported, sorry-free theorem is exercised by the nightly Lean gate; the Rust shell is exercised by crates/tooling/chio-conformance/tests/attenuation_witness_rejects_inflated_parent_scope.rs and the protocol-side check is implemented in chio_core_types::capability::CapabilityToken::validate_chain_binding.

Fail-closed admission soundness over the whole CurrentSchema domain: checkCurrentSchema admits only when the presented schema is the current Chio-owned one (any non-current schema is rejected before signature, time, floor, or budget checks). The theorem quantifies over all inputs and rules out admitting anything unrecognized, but the model is bounded to a two-constructor schema enum: it does NOT mechanize the wider hot-path verifier (chain-binding, signature, crypto floor, budgets) and does not model alternate Chio-owned capability schema rungs (none are exposed pre-release).

Sibling-sum budget enforcement: when the BudgetRegistry admits a child, the running sum after admission is bounded by the parent's share. This rejects cross-hop amplification where two siblings jointly oversubscribe their parent's budget. The root-imported, sorry-free theorem is exercised by the nightly Lean gate; the Rust shell is exercised by crates/tooling/chio-conformance/tests/budget_split_rejects_oversubscribed_siblings.rs and the cross-hop case by crates/tooling/chio-conformance/tests/budget_split_cross_hop_rejects_amplification.rs. The protocol-side check is implemented in chio_kernel_core::budget_split::BudgetSplit::try_admit_child.

Pure reservation folds preserve reserved = outstanding + committed + released + retained, with admitted child reserves bounded by sibling_sum_soundness. Apalache interleavings, the Kani and Creusot transition witnesses, the debug journal replay, and the stateful real-store test provide independent evidence for the defect family a6d26dbc4, c201afbd0, 84e98b9d0, and 58abf33d2. Scalar admission is linked; production ledger linkage is not established.

A finalized pure ledger is absorbing: it cannot reserve again or receive a second positive terminal disposition. Committed and released amount buckets may both be non-zero after partial realization, while the trace still has one terminal hold classification. The theorem is model-level; concrete hold terminality is checked by the debug journal replay and stateful real-store test, not by a production refinement proof.

Over finite requirement, evidence, and opaque digest domains, settlement admission implies Allow and proves every required finding purchase is verified and every required output digest matches. The M3 Rust linkage covers the digest comparison; the finding-purchase dimension is the explicit M4 composition boundary. This is not a Rust refinement proof and does not model SHA-256, canonical JSON, signatures, persistence, payment rails, or external settlement.
An Allow in the bounded delivery finalizer implies that any required finding purchase is verified and any required expected and observed digest identities are equal.

Every reachable deniedAfterDelivery result in the bounded model carries a blocked settlement gate, matching the M3 DeniedAfterDelivery and ContractualZeroCharge boundary without modeling the external rail.
